About MS Studio

Where tradition meets tiny smiles

MS Studio is Nashik's first dedicated baby shoot photography studio. We do two things, and we do them with all our heart: baby photography and maternity photography.

Our work is rooted in Maharashtrian and Indian culture — nath and nauvari, Peshwai pheta and Paithani, Little Krishna and Mahalakshmi. Every costume, prop and backdrop is chosen so your family's heritage shines through in every frame.

From the glow of pregnancy to the first birthday, we help you freeze the most precious months of life in timeless portraits you will treasure for generations.

  • Baby & maternity specialists
  • Traditional Maharashtrian themes
  • Gentle, patient with babies
  • Studios in Nashik & Vashi
With love, MS Studio

Questions, Answered

Everything parents ask us
✦
When should I book the newborn photoshoot?

Newborns are sleepiest and most flexible in their first two weeks, so we recommend booking during pregnancy and confirming the date as soon as your baby arrives.

When is the best time for a maternity shoot?

Most mothers are comfortable and glowing around the 7th to 8th month of pregnancy. We will help you pick the date and theme that suits you best.

Do you provide traditional costumes and props?

Yes. We style every shoot with traditional Maharashtrian costumes, jewellery, props and backdrops for babies — including Mahalakshmi, Peshwai, Little Krishna and festive themes. Message us to see the current collection.

Is it safe for my baby?

Your baby's comfort comes first. We keep the studio warm, take regular feeding and soothing breaks, and use only safe, hygienic props. Parents are always by their baby's side.

How long does a session take?

Baby sessions take a few hours because we work at your baby's pace — feeding, cuddles and naps are part of it. Maternity sessions are usually shorter. We will confirm timings when you book.

Do you only shoot babies and maternity?

Yes — we are specialists in baby and maternity photography, which lets us focus on doing this one thing exceptionally well.

Where are your studios?

We are in Nashik and Navi Mumbai (Vashi). Call or WhatsApp us for the exact location and directions.

How do I book?

Fill the enquiry form below, call us, or send a message on Instagram @ms_studio_kids. We will get back to you quickly.
